name: bengkel-app
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y mysql-server && sudo service mysql start && sudo mysql -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS bengkel_dev; CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'bengkel'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'secret'; GRANT ALL ON bengkel_dev.* TO 'bengkel'@'localhost'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;"
postStartCommand: sudo service mysql start && sudo chmod 755 /run/mysqld && sudo chmod 777 /run/mysqld/mysqld.sock || true
